status.summary: Former UFC welterweight champion. He won the title from Leon Edwards at UFC 304 (Jul 27, 2024) and lost it to Jack Della Maddalena at UFC 315 in Montreal (May 10, 2025; 47-48, 47-48, 46-49). Since then he has lost two more decisions: Ian Machado Garry (UD, Doha, Nov 22, 2025) and Gabriel Bonfim (45-50 x3 in a five-round main event, Las Vegas, Jun 6, 2026). That is three straight losses, at age 38. Nothing after Jun 6, 2026 is in the ufcstats snapshot (through Oct 31, 2026). This pass had no web access, so no booking, ranking, injury or retirement news could be checked.

signature: high-volume punching at distance: 10.2 significant attempts per minute decayed (division 8.4), 91% of landed strikes at distance
body strikes when opponents cover up: 39/41 body strikes landed against Gilbert Burns (UFC 288, May 2023)
takedowns and top control: 9/13 takedowns and 12:02 of control to take the title from Leon Edwards (UFC 304)
late-round output: in five-round fights his landing rate is 1.52x round 1 in round 4 and 1.61x in round 5
TKO of Sean Brady with punches at distance, R2 4:47 (UFC 280, Oct 2022), his only finish in his last 12 UFC fights (since Sep 2019)
weaknesses: no knockdowns scored in 22 UFC fights (347.6 minutes)
three straight decision losses since May 2025: out-landed 178-132 by Della Maddalena, 72-56 by Machado Garry and 128-86 by Bonfim
his takedowns have stopped working: 3/9 against Della Maddalena, 0/7 against Machado Garry, 0/2 against Bonfim
takes leg kicks: 1.0 leg strikes absorbed per minute decayed (division 0.66); Machado Garry landed 27/28 and Bonfim 34/37
low accuracy (40.4% decayed vs 47.7% for the division), and opponents land 52.2% on him over the last 3 years (career 44.8%)
style.summary: A pressure wrestle-boxer who wins on volume, cardio and control rather than power. He throws well above the welterweight average, mixes in takedowns and gets busier as fights go on, but he has never scored a UFC knockdown. Since winning the title he has lost three straight decisions to fighters who stopped his takedowns and out-landed him at range.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 87.9% head, 9.3% body, 2.8% legs, and landed strikes 77.9% head, 16.3% body, 5.8% legs. Career attempts are 86.6/9.1/4.3. Nearly all his output is punches to the head at distance (91% of decayed landed strikes at distance, 4.5% in the clinch), so head-punch weights are high and kicks are near zero. His leg attempts are under a third of the welterweight rate (9.3%). Body attempts are below the division rate (13.9%) but land well (16.3% of landed; 39/41 against Burns), so the three body moves share about 0.4 and lean to punches. ufcstats does not split jab, cross and hook. Jab and cross lead as a judgment from his high-volume straight-punch style, not a count. Spinning is 0, and head kicks and elbows near 0, because none appear in his finishes or the scouting data. No outside scouting source could be fetched this pass.

appearance.build: medium height and solidly built; 5 ft 11 in with a 72 in reach (ufcstats)

engine_notes.note: No power: 0 knockdowns in 22 UFC fights. His two UFC KO/TKO wins (Montano 2016, Brady 2022) came without a recorded knockdown.

Late surge is credible: five-round pace (1, 1.20, 1.16, 1.52, 1.61) is built on 25 min in each of rounds 2-5 across 5-6 fights. Opponents also land more on him late (5.32 absorbed per min and 57.6% accuracy in round 5), so late rounds get busier both ways.
Chin: 6 knockdowns absorbed in his career, all from 2016-2019 (Jouban 3, Luque 1, Neal 2). None in 263 head strikes absorbed over the last 3 years. 1 KO loss (Luque, 2016).
Decline signal: 0-3 since May 2025, strike differential -0.92 per minute over the last 3 years (career +0.44), and 0/9 takedowns in his last two fights.
